# The Wolf Among Us Remastered Wiki

> Fan wiki for The Wolf Among Us Remastered — the Telltale noir adventure remaster: story guides, characters, choices, Noir Mode and achievements.

Site: https://wolfamongusremastered.wiki

## About
Fan wiki for The Wolf Among Us Remastered, Telltale's noir remaster of the award-winning Fabletown adventure — story and chapter guides, character profiles, choice consequences, Noir Mode and release info.

## Guides
- [The Wolf Among Us Remastered Guide: Everything We Know](https://wolfamongusremastered.wiki/guide/wolf-among-us-remastered-guide): The complete guide to The Wolf Among Us Remastered — release date, platforms, what the remaster upgrades and how it fits the series.
- [First Time in Fabletown: A New Player Primer](https://wolfamongusremastered.wiki/guide/new-player-primer): New to The Wolf Among Us Remastered — what kind of game it is, how choices work and how to start Bigby's investigation.
- [The Story So Far: Fabletown Before the Remaster](https://wolfamongusremastered.wiki/story/story-so-far): The Wolf Among Us Remastered's setup — Fabletown, its exiled fairy tales and the murder that opens Bigby's case.
- [Chapter and Episode Breakdown](https://wolfamongusremastered.wiki/story/chapters): The Wolf Among Us Remastered chapter guide — all five episodes of the original season mapped for the remaster.
- [Bigby Wolf: The Big Bad Sheriff Character Guide](https://wolfamongusremastered.wiki/characters/bigby-wolf): Bigby Wolf profile — the Big Bad Wolf turned Fabletown sheriff, his abilities, temper and role in The Wolf Among Us Remastered.
- [Fabletown Cast: Every Major Character](https://wolfamongusremastered.wiki/characters/characters-cast): The Wolf Among Us Remastered cast — Snow White, Ichabod Crane, Beauty and the Beast, Mr. Toad and every major fable.
- [Choices and Consequences Guide](https://wolfamongusremastered.wiki/tips/choices-guide): The Wolf Among Us Remastered choices — which decisions matter, how Bigby's temper shapes the story and what carries between chapters.
- [Noir Mode, Achievements and Unlockables](https://wolfamongusremastered.wiki/tips/noir-mode-achievements): Noir Mode explained — the black-and-white filter, how to enable it, plus achievements and collectibles in The Wolf Among Us Remastered.
